Schema is Yoast WebPage/Organization rather than a full RoofingContractor LocalBusiness block.
top_issues: Google listing has no rating, no reviews and no website link - the site is not attached to the profile
Contact form is gated by reCAPTCHA, which blocks automated quote requests
Home page slider broken on mobile (blank panels)
Two sites/brands for the same company and phone could split local search signals

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Google listing exists with category, address and hours but no website link, no reviews and no rating - a customer's agent has almost nothing to verify against. robots.txt blocks wp-admin and backup folders but allows normal crawlers and does not list key AI bots; no explicit blocks seen. Answerable: hours/towns/services are real text and titles name the town, but there is no RoofingContractor JSON-LD with address/hours and no pricing. Bookable: 1 - Contact Form 7 with labelled fields but a reCAPTCHA challenge before submit, and no booking.

operations_signals.signal: Every quote arrives through a CAPTCHA-protected form or a phone call; nothing is auto-qualified
One-day roof completions plus a residential-only focus imply tight daily scheduling that a scheduler could optimise

top_opportunities.opportunity: Attach the site to the Google profile, claim/complete it and start collecting reviews (currently none visible)
top_opportunities.evidence: Maps listing shows no rating, no reviews and an 'Add website' prompt

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the CAPTCHA-gated Contact Form 7 with a labelled, tracked quote form plus instant auto-reply and booking
top_opportunities.evidence: Form includes _wpcf7_recaptcha_response and g-recaptcha-response fields, blocking any automated submission

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the mobile slider and merge the East Brunswick/Iselin sites into one canonical brand presence
top_opportunities.evidence: Blank grey slider panels on mobile; catamountroofs.com and iroofnj.com share one phone number

scores.reasons: Gap 4: unlinked listing with zero reviews and a CAPTCHA wall on the only quote form. Pay 3: ten-year-old residential-only roofer with modest public signals. Ease 4: profile fix and form swap are quick, slider/consolidation is medium. Evidence 3: site and listing inspected directly, review counts and revenue unknown.

caveats: Several sites share the same builder patterns (Wix auto-generated robots.txt text, an emoji prefix in page titles seen on Morano, Blue Apex, BSG, Roof Roof Roofing, Catamount, PMGC and even sbpallet.com); this may indicate a common web vendor - inference, not verified.

This batch contains many generic 'town + service' roofing listings (e.g. Top Pro Roofing Repair & Installation East Brunswick, East Brunswick Roofing Contractor Repair & Installation appearing alongside these). Some may be lead-generation brands rather than local shops; status judgements here are based only on what each business's own site and listing showed.
data_gaps: Google review counts for Blue Apex, National Roofers, BSG, Property Management General Contracting, Roof Roof Roofing and Catamount were not shown in the limited Maps view used; counts for those are unknown.
Neighborhood Roofing's site could not be reviewed beyond the error page because it returns HTTP 500; its on-page SEO and trust content are unknown.
Destefano Roofing & Contracting could not be confirmed as currently trading: no Google Maps match for the phone (732-613-0990) or the East Brunswick address, and no website.
BSG's robots.txt was not fetched, so its crawler permissions are assumed rather than observed.
